cards.card_text: But he says his persecutors and foes are many.
cards.verse_text: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.

cards.card_text: With so many persecutors and foes against him, the writer has turned from God's testimonies.

cards.card_text: Jeremiah asks the LORD to do something about his persecutors.
With the LORD with him like a fearsome warrior, what does Jeremiah say will happen to his persecutors?
cards.verse_text: Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail.
cards.snippet: Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail.

cards.card_text: Paul doesn't hide his past: he says he was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor and a violent man.
cards.verse_text: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
